parts.t: 20 ACRES! Long gated driveway to a spectacular family country estate in South Langley. Beautifully maintained landscaping throughout the property with breathtaking views of the farmland and greenery. Excellent future potential with 2 ROAD FRONTAGES on a peaceful flat parcel (NO CREEKS). 3944 SQFT 2 storey home (Roof is 3 years old) comes with an outdoor POOL (32x16), 6 Stall Horse barn with LOFT, Storage outbuilding (30x15), Helicopter Hanger (30x60) at the rear of the property. Enjoy country style living while being minutes away from the city.
